description: Before/after satellite comparison of the same area on two dates from NASA GIBS true-color imagery (MODIS or VIIRS, about 250 m per pixel): one side-by-side JPEG with date labels plus pixel-based change metrics (share of changed pixels, brightness change) and a cloud, haze and snow estimate for each date, with a plain-language reading that says whether the change is likely real or just weather. For floods, wildfires and burn scars, drought and lake levels, snow cover, deforestation or construction at regional scale. Params: place ("Valencia, Spain") or lat + lon + radius_km (5 to 500, default 50) or bbox, date_before (default one year before date_after), date_after (default yesterday), layer, width (64 to 768 per image, default 384), include_separate. Price: $0.013 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"lat":-18.75,"lon":-67.1,"radius_km":50,"date_before":"2014-05-10","date_after":"2016-05-10","width":256}.

include_separate.description: Also return both images separately as base64

place.description: Place name instead of coordinates, e.g. "Valencia, Spain" (GeoNames, cities and towns)

width.description: Width of each of the two images; the composite is 2 x width + 8 px
